Call for Quotations
Sealed quotations are invited from the appropriate firms for the supply of plastic
Neelkamal Chairs, (Model CHR-4025) without hands, as per the specifications given below: (For
vide publish it is kept in KUCE&T website www.kucet.ac.in)

S.
No Particular Qty
Plastic Neelkamal Chairs, (Model CHR-4025)
1
without hands 100
The sealed cover of quotations should reach or submit to undersigned on or before 13-06-2025.

PRINCIPAL
Terms & Conditions:
1. Payment will be after receiving goods/material in good condition.
2. Payment will be as early as possible within week time after delivery of goods.
3. Mention clearly all the charges CGST, SGST, etc.. in the quotation..
